summary: Built position-mode evaluation for the scenario suite, ran its two preregistered validation checks, and reported that the suite fails to reproduce known whole-game policy ordering; then measured which public board properties predict exactly achievable clear rate and found the frozen leaf's weights nearly orthogonal to that direction.
validationPerformed: Comparator parity against the frozen depth-4 decision function, 120 moves, 0 mismatches; scenario-engine parity re-run over 218,470 moves, 0 mismatches.
Information-boundary check over 768 decisions with 0 violations: redrawing the entire hidden future never changed a fair policy's move.
1,024 positions labelled with an exact eight-move clear optimum averaged over independent hidden-board and future completions; whole-position held-out split.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
Exploratory namespace only; does not upgrade docs/research/ or any frozen protocol.
The suite is a diagnostic corpus only; its ranking claim is retired and no number computed on it may be cited as evidence of policy strength.
The added cover-cracking feature block gains far less on fair-play positions than on synthetic ones and may be a generation artifact.
